# `fs` standard library

The `fs` module provides high-level safe abstractions for filesystem path manipulation,
file and directory CRUD operations, metadata querying, directory traversal, filesystem
capacity inspection, and file attribute formatting.

All operations avoid raw pointer arithmetic, using typed `#packed` records (`StatRaw`,
`Statvfs`, `DirentPrefix`) and safe options `<T | >`.

```{.dva .run}
#use fs
#use io

io::out $ fs::join("/tmp", "example.txt")
```

## Types and Records

| Type | Kind | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fs::Metadata` | Record | `size, mode, mtime, mtime_nsec, atime, is_dir, is_file, is_symlink, is_exec` | High-level file metadata returned by `fs::stat` and `fs::lstat_meta` |
| `fs::DirEntry` | Record | `name, is_dir, is_file, is_symlink` | Directory entry returned by `fs::read_dir` |
| `fs::Entry` | Record | `name, is_dir, is_exec, size, fmt_size, perms, mtime` | Rich directory entry with formatted strings returned by `fs::list_dir` |
| `fs::FsSpace` | Record | `total_bytes, free_bytes, available_bytes` | Filesystem capacity statistics returned by `fs::space` |
| `fs::StatRaw` | `#packed` | POSIX `struct stat` layout (144 bytes) | Low-level stat layout |
| `fs::Statvfs` | `#packed` | POSIX `struct statvfs` layout (112 bytes) | Low-level statvfs layout |
| `fs::DirentPrefix` | `#packed` | `d_ino, d_off, d_reclen, d_type` (19 bytes) | Low-level dirent prefix |

## Function catalog

| Category | Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Primitives** | `fs::join(p1, p2)` | `String, String => String` | Joins two path components cleanly with a single slash |
| | `fs::parent(p)` | `String => String` | Returns the directory containing the given path |
| | `fs::basename(p)` | `String => String` | Returns the trailing filename component of a path |
| | `fs::ext(p)` | `String => String` | Returns the file extension (including leading `.`) or empty string |
| | `fs::is_abs(p)` | `String => <>` | Checks if a path is absolute (starts with `/`) |
| | `fs::cwd()` | `() => String` | Returns the current working directory |
| | `fs::home()` | `() => String` | Returns user's home directory from `$HOME` |
| | `fs::resolve(p)` | `String => String` | Resolves canonical absolute path using `realpath` |
| **File & Dir CRUD** | `fs::read_to_string(p)` | `String => <String \| >` | Reads an entire file into an owned String |
| | `fs::write_file(p, s)` | `String, String => <>` | Writes full string content to a file (creates or truncates) |
| | `fs::copy_file(src, dst)` | `String, String => <>` | Copies file contents from source to destination |
| | `fs::rename_path(old, new)` | `String, String => <>` | Atomically renames/moves a file or directory |
| | `fs::create_dir(p)` | `String => <>` | Creates a single directory with permissions `0755` |
| | `fs::create_dir_all(p)` | `String => <>` | Recursively creates parent directories as needed |
| | `fs::remove(p)` | `String => <>` | Removes a single file or empty directory |
| | `fs::remove_all(p)` | `String => <>` | Recursively removes a directory tree or single file |
| **Metadata & Query** | `fs::stat(p)` | `String => <Metadata \| >` | Queries file metadata (follows symlinks) |
| | `fs::lstat_meta(p)` | `String => <Metadata \| >` | Queries metadata without following symlinks |
| | `fs::exists(p)` | `String => <>` | Checks if a file or directory exists |
| | `fs::is_file(p)` | `String => <>` | Checks if path is a regular file |
| | `fs::is_dir(p)` | `String => <>` | Checks if path is a directory |
| | `fs::is_symlink(p)` | `String => <>` | Checks if path is a symbolic link |
| | `fs::mtime(p)` | `String => Int` | Returns modification timestamp in seconds |
| | `fs::size(p)` | `String => Int` | Returns file size in bytes |
| | `fs::readlink_path(p)` | `String => <String \| >` | Reads the target of a symbolic link |
| **Traversal & Space** | `fs::read_dir(p)` | `String => DirEntry{}` | Lists immediate child entries in a directory |
| | `fs::list_dir(p, h, m, r)` | `String, <>, Int, <> => Entry{}` | Lists, formats, and sorts entries with dirs first |
| | `fs::space(p)` | `String => <FsSpace \| >` | Queries total, free, and available bytes via statvfs |
| | `fs::get_fs_stats(p)` | `String => (Int, Int, Int, Int)` | Returns `(used_gb, total_gb, pct, free_gb)` |
| **Formatters** | `fs::format_size(sz, is_dir)` | `Int, <> => String` | Human-readable size format (`"12 KB"`, `"1.4 GB"`, `"DIR"`) |
| | `fs::format_perms(m, is_dir)` | `Int, <> => String` | Formats mode bits into standard `"rwxr-xr-x"` format |
| | `fs::format_time(ts)` | `Int => String` | Formats timestamp into `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"` |
| | `fs::format_number(n)` | `Int => String` | Formats number with commas (`1,000,000`) |
| | `fs::auto_rename_path(p)` | `String => String` | Generates non-colliding duplicate name (`"file (1).txt"`) |

## Example usage

```{.dva .run}
#use fs
#use io

dir = fs::parent("/usr/local/bin")
io::out $ "Parent: " + dir

ext = fs::ext("archive.tar.gz")
io::out $ "Ext: " + ext

sz_str = fs::format_size(1048576, <->)
io::out $ "Size: " + sz_str
```
